name: Private-school shuffle four
desc: A jazzier, swung take on the amapiano four: soft 909 kick under triplet-shuffle shakers ([sh@2 sh] elongation) with ghost-note gains, a syncopated late-swung rimshot conversation, and rolling Visco tom accents. Loose, human, dusty - the private-school pocket.

kickcut.doc: kick lpf Hz - lower = softer thud

code.full: stack(s("bd*4").bank("RolandTR909").shape(.26).lpf(${kickcut}).gain(${gain}*.95), s("[sh@2 sh]*4").gain(".55 .28 .5 .3 .52 .28 .48 .32").hpf(600).lpf(sine.range(${shkcut}*.7, ${shkcut}*1.1).slow(24)).pan(cosine.range(.35,.65).slow(16)).room(.18).every(8, x=>x.ply(2)), s("~ rim [~ rim] rim ~").bank("RolandTR909").gain(${gain}*.48).late("[0 .02]*2").room(.22), s("~ ~ cp ~").bank("RolandTR909").gain(${gain}*.4).room(.25), s("lt ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ [lt lt] ~").bank("ViscoSpaceDrum").speed(1.1).gain(${gain}*.32).room(.2)).fast(${rate}).orbit(1).play()
code.peak: stack(s("bd*4").bank("RolandTR909").shape(.3).lpf(${kickcut}*1.2).gain(${gain}*.95), s("[sh@2 sh]*4").gain(".6 .3 .5 .32 .58 .3 .48 .34").hpf(600).lpf(sine.range(${shkcut}*.8, ${shkcut}*1.3).slow(16)).pan(cosine.range(.3,.7).slow(16)).every(4, x=>x.ply(2)), s("~ rim [~ rim] rim [rim ~]").bank("RolandTR909").gain(${gain}*.5).late("[0 .02]*2").room(.22), s("~ ~ cp ~").bank("RolandTR909").gain(${gain}*.42).room(.25), s("lt ~ [lt lt] ~ ~ ~ [lt lt] lt").bank("ViscoSpaceDrum").speed(1.1).gain(${gain}*.36).room(.2).mask("<1 1 0 1>")).fast(${rate}).orbit(1).play()
